businesses.business: personal lines property and casualty insurance

offering_description.value: Holding company whose subsidiary Kingstone Insurance Company writes personal lines property and casualty insurance, mainly homeowners, dwelling fire, personal umbrella and personal auto policies. Sells to individual policyholders mainly in New York through independent retail agents and brokers. Earns premiums and investment income.

primary_products.value: homeowners insurance; dwelling fire insurance; personal umbrella insurance; personal automobile insurance; other liability and cooperative/condo coverage

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual homeowners, renters and drivers in New York and other northeastern states

end_markets.value: personal property and casualty insurance; residential homeowners coverage

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums written and earned on personal lines policies, plus investment income on the portfolio; commissions or management fees: ceding commissions from reinsurers and policy fees
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites and carries risk on personal lines policies, sold to individuals via independent agents, buys reinsurance

geography_served.value: US regional: Primarily New York, with some other states such as New Jersey, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Connecticut, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania

specialization.value: related lines: homeowners, dwelling fire, umbrella and personal auto, all personal lines insurance

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent retail agents and brokerages that sell policies to consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed insurer regulated by the New York Department of Financial Services and other state insurance regulators, rate and solvency rules
